title: bupleurum falcatum var. scorzonerifolium
intro: Bupleurum falcatum var. scorzonerifolium, commonly known as Japanese hare's ear, is a plant species within the genus Bupleurum. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine and has been associated with various health benefits, including reducing stress, improving mood, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Japanese hare's ear are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve liver function, and exert anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
